notes.recognition: Slate steps and angular spires establish the highest, hardest terrain family.
notes.agency: Every concept preserves one traversable top path despite the stronger silhouette.
notes.specificity: Pressure-cut slate and cold inclusions fit Xenovoya's mineral world.
notes.restraint: Cyan appears only in small seams and mineral nodes.
notes.continuity: Blue-black planes and mica edges match the approved slate surface.
notes.reusability: Spire clusters, stepped shoulders, and pass edges support modular combinations.
notes.accessibility: Elevation, steps, and spires communicate mountain identity independently of color.
